info.name: Khoa — User and Learning Content v0.1

request.description: Proposed synchronizer token with short-lived server pre-session; no access JWT required. Return Cache-Control:no-store and HttpOnly pre-session cookie. Rotate/destroy pre-session on login, get new CSRF token for authenticated session. Tokens not in URL/logs; no business data. Login requires configured Origin check as additional defense.

exec: if ((pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "").includes("json")) { const b=pm.response.json(); if(b.csrfToken) pm.environment.set("csrfToken",b.csrfToken); for(const k of ["userId","courseId","moduleId","lessonId","contentId","vocabularyId"]) if(b[k]) pm.environment.set(k,b[k]); }

request.description: Email trim/lowercase <=254, no dot/+tag stripping. Password code point/UTF-8 byte checks; BCrypt. fullName blank => null. Unknown fields including role =>400. Assign LEARNER; seeded Admin only. No implicit login. 409 REGISTRATION_CONFLICT generic message; transactional account/profile creation.

request.description: Generic 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS for absent email, incorrect password or blocked account. Set access_token cookie (HttpOnly; Secure on HTTPS; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1; host-only). 30 minute JWT default environment configurable; no refresh. JSON never returns JWT. Rotate pre-session and CSRF state; fetch /auth/csrf again after successful login.

request.description: Validate CSRF and current JWT. Persist jti/exp in User DB before deleting access_token with identical Path/Domain scope, Max-Age=0. Also invalidate CSRF/pre-session state. request.description: Synchronous atomic file import. Auth/CSRF then target/container/whole file validation before one Content transaction. No skip/update/partial success. Duplicate DB or commit race409 rollback. Validation422, malformed container400, limits413, wrong format415. No business rows on failure; ImportError holds location/counts. Two files are separate transactions. Do not automatically retry after response loss; inspect created records before resending, duplicate returns409.
